atoms.text: Tables are a handy way to record information. Tables usually look something like this.

instruction.text: In this table you can see what Eva and Kim like to drink. Who likes tea? Select the correct name.

hint.text: Eva likes to drink tea because to the right of her name and under Tea there is a tick.

instruction.text: And who likes to drink water? Select the correct name.

hint.text: We can see that Kim likes to drink water because to the right of her name and under Water there is a tick.

instruction.text: Look at the table. Who’s favourite colour is green?
